What are the best and the worst console to PC ports in your opinion? For me, I'd have to say that [*Ace Combat Assault Horizon - Enhanced Edition*](http://store.steampowered.com/app/228400/), and the [*Dark Souls*](http://store.steampowered.com/app/211420/) port were some of the worst. Even though Dark Souls is considered to be a great game, the keyboard controls were horrible, so if you didn't have a controller, you were pretty much screwed. Also, it was locked at 30 FPS, and if you used DSFix to unlock the FPS to 60, the hit-detection on ladders could bug out, and if you slid down them, you'd fall off, and usually fall to your death. For the best, I'd have to say some of the *Devil May Cry* games. The keyboard controls were advanced to do combos on, but at-least they made sense, and actually functioned.

What do you guys think?
